title: Compatible perfect matching
statement: Let $n,k,q$ be natural numbers, and let $(S_i)_{i=1}^q$ be finite subsets of $ in n$ whose symmetric difference is empty and each of which has cardinality $k$. Choose any permutation of the $k$ positions for each part. In the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part, there is a perfect matching such that the two endpoints of every matching edge receive the same label in $ in n$, where the label of a vertex is the element of its part’s set selected by the chosen permutation and an enumeration of that set.
